title: Himeji municipality — landscape walk and Otokoyama park

facts.fact: The municipal landscape map confirms Otokoyama Haisuiike Park is a hilltop park reached by stairs, with a full castle view.
facts.excerpt: 男山配水池公園は、姫路城を一望する男山
facts.location: 公園・広場 > 男山配水池公園

facts.fact: The municipality distinguishes the garden site and nearby institutions within the castle-side landscape map; Koko-en is nine gardens with paid entry.
facts.excerpt: 好古園への入場は有料
facts.location: 姫路城周辺施設 > 好古園
